reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and no redline or comment was proposed — consistent with the expectation that compliant findings are retained as internal evidence only.
The cited text supports compliance: neither paragraph 4(a) nor paragraph 5 imposes liquidated damages, penalties, an early-termination fee, or a minimum-fee obligation on the Customer (AP).

Paragraph 4(a)'s entitlement of Kubient to 'all fees generated during the termination period' is properly read against the revenue-share model in paragraph 5 as Kubient's share of Advertiser-generated revenue rather than a sum the Customer pays out, so it does not trigger the rule (which applies only where the Customer pays).

Rationale correctly flags the Exhibit-level fee terms as out of scope and notes the 3-months' fees fallback should any Exhibit add a Customer-payable termination or shortfall amount; the reference to paragraph 62 is contextual and does not undermine the conclusion.
No deterministic check failures and no unnecessary edits to otherwise acceptable language.
